title: Wire real VirtualWorld snapshot/restore and lifecycle checkpoints into TimelineManager

sections.what: Replace broken serialize_world/deserialize_world imports in routes/timeline_ops.py and routes/action.py with real VirtualWorld snapshot/restore on world.timeline_manager, seed Tick-0 checkpoints on load/reset, record checkpoints across turn/timeskip/date jumps, and round-trip timeline state through savegames without recursive snapshot bloat.
sections.why: routes/timeline_ops.py (_snapshot_world, _restore_world) and routes/action.py (apply_turn_decay) currently import non-existent serialize_world and deserialize_world from engine.serialization inside try/except blocks, silently saving {'time_ticks': N} stubs and returning restored: false on every branch switch or redo.
sections.how: Attach TimelineManager to VirtualWorld (virtual_world_engine.py) and expose compact snapshot_for_timeline(world) / restore_from_timeline(world, snapshot) helpers in engine/timeline.py using world.to_dict() (popping 'timeline', 'areas', 'rooms', 'areas_by_id') and world.load_from_dict() while preserving _scenario_source and _scenario_name. Seed Tick-0 checkpoint after load_from_dict and /api/reset (routes/saveload.py). Record checkpoints in routes/action.py (apply_turn_decay, world_advance), routes/timeskip_ops.py (handle_timeskip), and routes/settings.py (set_date). Load data['timeline'] in WorldSerializer.load_from_dict and include it in to_dict(include_timeline=True).

acceptance.text: VirtualWorld owns timeline_manager (TimelineManager) initialized with a Tick-0 checkpoint on boot, load_from_dict, and /api/reset
routes/timeline_ops.py _snapshot_world and _restore_world use world.to_dict() and world.load_from_dict() instead of missing serialize_world/deserialize_world symbols
Checkpoint snapshots strip nested timeline and derived area projections so snapshots never recursively bloat
Checkpoints are recorded on /api/turn/apply, /api/world/timeskip, /api/world/advance, and /api/settings/date, and round-trip through savegames

custom.browser_ui: Clicking Checkpoint, + Fork, branch pills in #timeline-branch-bar, or Redo on a turn card restores real VirtualWorld positions, inventory, vitals, and clock state rather than returning restored: false.
